query: INSERT INTO device_attestation_state (challenge_id, token_id, device_id, wireguard_key, created_at, expires_at, payload) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (token_id) DO UPDATE SET challenge_id = EXCLUDED.challenge_id, device_id = EXCLUDED.device_id, wireguard_key = EXCLUDED.wireguard_key, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, payload = EXCLUDED.payload
